entries.text: The Guild announces it will put the party forward for the C-rank promotion exam; Domas brings written terms and Ellie lays out the forms.
entries.evidence: the Guild will put you forward for the C-rank exam

entries.text: The party is in the Aegis City Guild hall; Vallie announces from the stairs, Domas holds the written terms, Ellie has the forms ready, and Tobias watches from behind the counter.
entries.evidence: Tobias watches from behind the counter.

entries.text: The Guild will put the party forward for the C-rank promotion exam this season.
entries.evidence: the Guild will put you forward for the C-rank exam

entries.text: The C-rank exam involves an interview, then a week to prepare for a Guild-chosen C-rank quest with an observer appointed by Guildmaster Vallie.
entries.evidence: The interview is next, and then a week to prepare for a C-rank quest of the Guild's choosing, with an observer appointed by Guildmaster Vallie herself.

entries.text: The observer's verdict decides whether the party rises to C-rank or fails.
entries.evidence: Once the observer gives their verdict, you'll either rise to C-rank or...

entries.text: Max tells the Guild to put the party down for the C-rank promotion exam, and Ellie begins the sign-up paperwork.
entries.evidence: Put us down for the exam.

entries.text: Ellie fills out the C-rank exam forms and slides them to the party for signatures at three marked spots.
entries.evidence: Now we just need the party's signatures here, here, and here.

entries.text: The scene is the Aegis City Guild hall, with Vallie announcing from the stairs, Domas holding written terms, Ellie at the forms, and Tobias behind the counter.
entries.evidence: Tobias watches from behind the counter.

arcs.text: The party must decide whether to sign the C-rank promotion exam forms and put their names down this season.
The party must complete the C-rank exam interview and then survive a week of preparation for a Guild-chosen C-rank quest judged by Vallie's appointed observer.
The party must sign the completed C-rank exam forms Ellie has prepared before the sign-up is finalized.
